title.narrative: Promotion of Electric Vehicles in Cabo Verde

description.narrative: The Government of Cabo Verde identified the promotion of electric vehicles (EV) as one of the main activities that are required for reducing the road transport-related greenhouse has (GHG) emissions as well as local air pollution and noise. The objective of the project is to support the Government in further developing and implementing its strategy for the promotion of EVs. An Electric Mobility Facility (EMF) will facilitate investments into electric cars and buses, as well as charging stations, primarily through rebates. The budget of the project is EUR 7,186,646, out of which 56% are allocated to the EMF. The funds will leverage contributions from Cabo Verde of EUR 5.4 million, as well as public and private investment in EVs and charging stations of approx. EUR 12.3 million. The direct emission savings over the lifetime of the technology are expected to amount to 19,890 tCO2e, along with the generation of considerable co-benefits, including reduced air pollution and noise.
